feature.name: Model_Federation
feature.description: Root feature representing the Model Federation approach proposed in the article.

feature.name: Structural
feature.description: Structural dimension covering artefacts, links, graph structure, formalisms, domain and technological context of Model Federation.

feature.name: Artefacts
feature.description: Category grouping the different types of models used in federation.

feature.name: Software_Model
feature.description: Software model representing code artifacts. Trace: [Article_5 §Software_Model]

feature.name: Analysis_Model
feature.description: Analysis model used for performance and NFP evaluation. Trace: [Article_9 §Analysis_Model]

feature.name: Hardware_Model
feature.description: Hardware model describing physical components and connections. Trace: [Article_5 §Hardware_Model]

feature.name: Links
feature.description: Category of relationships linking artefacts across domains.

feature.name: Traceability_Link
feature.description: Link enabling cross-model traceability between artefacts. Trace: [Article_9 §Cross_Model_Traceability]

feature.name: Consistency_Link
feature.description: Link ensuring consistency constraints between related models. Trace: [Article_13 §Consistency_Preservation]

feature.name: Graph_Structure
feature.description: Structural representation of models and their interconnections.

feature.name: Formalism_Transformation_Graph
feature.description: Formalism Transformation Graph (FTG) capturing formalisms and their mappings. Trace: [Article_4 §FTG]

feature.name: Process_Model
feature.description: Process Model (PM) defining the order of operations on models. Trace: [Article_4 §PM]

feature.name: Formalisms
feature.description: Set of formal modeling languages supported in the federation.

feature.name: Queueing_Network
feature.description: Queueing network formalism for performance analysis. Trace: [Article_9 §Queueing_Network]

feature.name: Stochastic_Petri_Net
feature.description: Stochastic Petri net formalism for concurrent system modeling. Trace: [Article_9 §Stochastic_Petri_Net]

feature.name: Markov_Chain
feature.description: Markov chain formalism for probabilistic behavior modeling. Trace: [Article_9 §Markov_Chain]

feature.name: Fault_Tree
feature.description: Fault tree formalism for reliability analysis. Trace: [Article_9 §Fault_Tree]

feature.name: Probabilistic_Time_Automata
feature.description: Probabilistic time automata formalism for timed probabilistic analysis. Trace: [Article_9 §Probabilistic_Time_Automata]

feature.name: Domain_Context
feature.description: Domain-specific contexts addressed by the federation.

feature.name: Robotics
feature.description: Robotics domain models expressed via ROS protocol files. Trace: [Article_5 §ROS]

feature.name: Mechatronics
feature.description: Mechatronics domain models using Visio-based UML diagrams. Trace: [Article_5 §Visio_UML]

feature.name: Technological_Context
feature.description: Technologies and standards enabling model integration.

feature.name: OSLC
feature.description: Open Services for Lifecycle Collaboration (OSLC) standard for tool integration. Trace: [Article_6 §OSLC]

feature.name: OTIF
feature.description: Open Tool Integration Framework (OTIF) for meta-model based transformations. Trace: [Article_1 §OTIF]

feature.name: ETI
feature.description: Electronic Tool Integration (ETI) framework using web services for lightweight data exchange. Trace: [Article_1 §ETI]

feature.name: Metamodels
feature.description: Metamodel definitions used to describe and relate federated models.

feature.name: V_SUM
feature.description: V-SUM metamodel providing virtual single underlying model concepts. Trace: [Article_2 §V_SUM]

feature.name: Operational
feature.description: Operational dimension covering processes, queries, synchronization, validation, management and automation in Model Federation.

feature.name: Queries
feature.description: Mechanisms for retrieving information from the federated model repository.

feature.name: Automatic_Query
feature.description: Automatically generated queries to retrieve model information without user intervention. Trace: [Article_9 §Automatic_Query]

feature.name: Synchronisation
feature.description: Processes to keep federated models consistent over time.

feature.name: Incremental_Propagation
feature.description: Incremental propagation of changes across linked models. Trace: [Article_9 §Incremental_Propagation]

feature.name: Validation
feature.description: Activities to verify model correctness and non-functional properties.

feature.name: Consistency_Validation
feature.description: Validation of consistency constraints between models. Trace: [Article_13 §Consistency_Validation]

feature.name: NFP_Validation
feature.description: Validation of non-functional property (NFP) requirements. Trace: [Article_9 §NFP_Validation]

feature.name: Management
feature.description: Operations for handling model repositories and process orchestration.

feature.name: Model_Repository_Management
feature.description: Management of model repository storing native model artifacts. Trace: [Article_1 §Repository]

feature.name: Process_Orchestration
feature.description: Orchestration of process steps to support agile co-evolution of models. Trace: [Article_13 §Process_Orchestration]

feature.name: Automation
feature.description: Automation techniques to reduce manual effort in model analysis and design space exploration.

feature.name: Metaheuristic_Reduction
feature.description: Use of metaheuristic algorithms to reduce design space size for exploration. Trace: [Article_9 §Metaheuristic_Reduction]

feature.name: Automated_Process_Steps
feature.description: Automation of software process steps based on available information. Trace: [Article_9 §Automated_Process_Steps]

feature.name: Intentional
feature.description: Intentional dimension addressing goals such as traceability, consistency assurance, transformation management, composition and conceptual elicitation.

feature.name: Traceability
feature.description: Goals related to tracking relationships between model elements across domains.

feature.name: Cross_Model_Traceability_Goal
feature.description: Goal of achieving cross-model traceability for impact analysis. Trace: [Article_9 §Cross_Model_Traceability]

feature.name: Consistency_Assurance
feature.description: Goal of maintaining consistency among federated models.

feature.name: Consistency_Preservation
feature.description: Preservation of consistency constraints during model evolution. Trace: [Article_13 §Consistency_Preservation]

feature.name: Transformation_Management
feature.description: Management of model transformations to preserve semantics.

feature.name: Transformation_Rules_Management
feature.description: Definition and enforcement of transformation rules within the V-SUM metamodel. Trace: [Article_2 §Transformation_Management]

feature.name: Composition
feature.description: Goal of composing multiple models into a coherent federation.

feature.name: Model_Composition
feature.description: Composition of models from different domains to form a unified view. Trace: [Article_5 §Model_Composition]

feature.name: Conceptual_Elicitation
feature.description: Goal of eliciting stakeholder intentions and viewpoints.

feature.name: Stakeholder_Viewpoint_Integration
feature.description: Integration of stakeholder viewpoints into the federated model. Trace: [Article_13 §Stakeholder_Viewpoint_Integration]

feature.name: Roles
feature.description: Stakeholder roles involved in the federation process.

feature.name: Methodologist_Role
feature.description: Methodologist defines metamodels and view types for federation. Trace: [Article_2 §Methodologist]

feature.name: Developer_Role
feature.description: Developer creates and manipulates views derived from the V-SUM. Trace: [Article_2 §Developer]
